ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious AccessMask Requested From LSASS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects process handle on LSASS process with certain access mask Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectName, AccessMask, AccessList, ProcessName

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4656 AND ObjectName = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND (AccessMask = RGX(".*0x40.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1400.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x100000.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1410.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1010.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1438.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x143a.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1418.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1f0fff.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1f1fff.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1f2fff.*") OR AccessMask = RGX(".*0x1f3fff.*"))) OR (event_id = 4663 AND ObjectName = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND (AccessList = RGX(".*4484.*") OR AccessList = RGX(".*4416.*")))) AND  NOT (((ProcessName = RGX("\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\GamingServices\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\lsm\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\minionhost\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\MRT\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\perfmon\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\procexp\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\procexp64\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\taskmgr\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\thor\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\thor64\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\vmtoolsd\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\VsTskMgr\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\wininit\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\wmiprvse\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("RtkAudUService64$")) AND (ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\.*") OR ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysNative\\\\.*") OR ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWow64\\\\.*") OR ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\asgard2\\-agent\\\\.*"))) OR ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files.*") OR (ProcessName = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\taskhostw\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\CCM\\\\CcmExec\\\.exe$")) OR (ProcessName = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Sysmon64\\\.exe$") AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*")) OR (ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\asgard2\\-agent\\-sc\\\\aurora\\\\.*") AND ProcessName = RGX("\\\\aurora\\-agent\\-64\\\.exe$") AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*")) OR (ProcessName = RGX("\\\\x64\\\\SCENARIOENGINE\\\.EXE$") AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*")) OR ((ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND ProcessName = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\is\\-.*")) AND ProcessName = RGX("\\\\avira\\_system\\_speedup\\\.tmp$") AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*")) OR (ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND ProcessName = RGX("\\\\avira\\_speedup\\_setup\\_update\\\.tmp$") AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*")) OR (ProcessName = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\snmp\\\.exe$") AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*")) OR (ProcessName = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SystemTemp\\\\.*") AND ProcessName = RGX("\\\\GoogleUpdate\\\.exe$") AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*"))) AND  NOT (((ProcessName = RGX("\\\\procmon64\\\.exe$") OR ProcessName = RGX("\\\\procmon\\\.exe$")) AND AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4484.*")))
